consumerApplicabilityReview.precondition: gRPC server with method-path authorization interceptor using canonical DENY rules and fallback ALLOW
consumerApplicabilityReview.proofNeeded: Complete build-tag-selected consumer source/call closure showing no gRPC server or no affected authorization pattern. root gRPC package compilation alone cannot prove client role.

consumerApplicabilityReview.precondition: xDS/authz RBAC flaws OR generic HTTP2 gRPC server rapid-reset resource exhaustion
consumerApplicabilityReview.proofNeeded: Cover every advisory branch. Proven absence of xDS/authz in the three authenticated consumers only closes those branches; establish actual generic server absence by complete consumer closure.

consumerApplicabilityReview.precondition: HTTP2 server permits duplicate connection-level flow-control refund when reset stream data is later read
consumerApplicabilityReview.proofNeeded: Actual owning compiled source closure proving no reachable HTTP2 server; do not treat broad generated client-symbol list as proof of client vulnerability or absence of server.

consumerApplicabilityReview.precondition: HTTP1 server handler returns a 2xx CONNECT response without hijacking, enabling tunnel/request interpretation mismatch
consumerApplicabilityReview.proofNeeded: Complete reachable handler routing and CONNECT behavior at shipped source/tag/byte identity. Server presence alone does not establish vulnerable CONNECT behavior.

consumerApplicabilityReview.precondition: IDNA normalization disagreement is used for host privilege checks; vulnerable HTTP client or IDNA conversions participate
consumerApplicabilityReview.decision: unknown; client-only label does not clear
consumerApplicabilityReview.proofNeeded: Specific hostname authorization/normalization flow or owning fixed package, including vendored and standard-library variants.

consumerApplicabilityReview.precondition: HTTP2 client accepts malformed response framing headers that are forwarded to insufficiently strict HTTP1 peer
consumerApplicabilityReview.decision: unknown; client-only label does not clear
consumerApplicabilityReview.proofNeeded: Complete response-forwarding closure proving no relevant proxy/HTTP1 sink, or verified owning fixed package.

consumerApplicabilityReview.precondition: HTTP1 CONNECT request with nonempty body is rejected with keep-alive response; Transport reuse can expose a poisoned subsequent response
consumerApplicabilityReview.decision: unknown; client-only label does not clear
consumerApplicabilityReview.proofNeeded: Complete CONNECT request construction/body and shared Transport reuse behavior, or verified owning fixed package.

consumerApplicabilityReview.precondition: Active Go module fetching with affected sumdb/tlog code; malicious GOPROXY or coordinated GOPROXY/GOSUMDB breaks module authenticity
consumerApplicabilityReview.decision: unknown; security-sensitive client flow, no server exemption
consumerApplicabilityReview.proofNeeded: Exact owning compiled package closure proving affected sumdb/tlog implementation uncompiled or inactive. Packages containing toolchain cmd/go require fixed toolchain/source/backport evidence.

recommendedSequence.action: Reuse existing source/binary evidence for one bounded hosted complete consumer-edge extraction at exact three authenticated source trees and shipped build tags, only if payoff warrants it. Extract actual imports and server/handler constructors/call edges outside the vulnerable library; include init/reflection/registration, test and build-tag selection. No rebuild or native rescan until proof or fixed candidate changes.
targets: HTTP2 server/CONNECT handler cases where actual remaining owner is bound
recommendedSequence.acceptance: Authenticated owning source/archive plus exact current bytes and complete affected-implementation closure; subset paths only; preserve unresolved branches.

recommendedSequence.owner: Fedora package maintainers + owning upstreams; Finite packaging integrator
recommendedSequence.action: Obtain signed compatible owning-package updates/backports for actual AnyIO, rclone, Go client/network and archive risk. An updated compiler does not patch embedded modules.
recommendedSequence.unblockEvent: Approved publisher package/source release or documented specific backport; authenticated transaction and new affected executable/module identities.

recommendedSequence.owner: Finite security reviewer + Fedora container tools maintainers
recommendedSequence.action: Retain go-archive crafted tar overwrite and Skopeo SELinux process-label findings until targeted source proof or owning fix. SELinux-enforcing desktop does not establish mitigation.
recommendedSequence.unblockEvent: Specific validated archive traversal fix, or exact absent/protected extraction path; exact Skopeo labeling call closure covering affected procfs operations.

recommendedSequence.action: Continue development-only signed package and dependency remediation independently of cleared standard profiles.
recommendedSequence.unblockEvent: Shipped bytes/source join and verified upstream fix/backport for each affected development consumer.
